description: List conversation log events for a specific Zendesk ticket. Use this action when you need to retrieve the chronological history of interactions, comments, and activities on a ticket. The conversation log provides a comprehensive view of all events including comments, status changes, and other ticket activities. Supports cursor-based pagination for accessing large datasets.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing conversation log events for a ticket.

page_after.description: Cursor token to fetch records after this position
page_after.human_parameter_description: Cursor token from the previous page to get the next set of results.
page_after.title: Page After

page_before.description: Cursor token to fetch records before this position
page_before.human_parameter_description: Cursor token from the previous page to get the previous set of results.
page_before.title: Page Before

page_size.description: Number of records per page for cursor pagination (max 100)
page_size.human_parameter_description: How many conversation log events to show on each page. You can choose up to 100.
page_size.title: Page Size

sort.description: Field to sort results by. Prefix with `-` for descending order
sort.human_parameter_description: Pick the field to sort by (e.g., created_at). Use minus prefix (-) for descending order.
sort.title: Sort

ticket_id.description: The ID of the ticket to retrieve conversation log for
ticket_id.human_parameter_description: The number of the Zendesk ticket. You can find this ID in the ticket URL or from a ticket list.
ticket_id.title: Ticket Id
